source.title: Ecommerce URL Structure Best Practices | Google Search Central
source.note: Guidance covers consistent canonical URLs, pagination URLs, duplicate alternatives, crawlable links and empty category handling.

releaseGates.question: Should this be a stable indexable collection, a user filter or an existing destination?
releaseGates.acceptance: Clean persistent URL, intended self-canonical for approved indexable landing page, matching internal/sitemap URLs, no accidental noindex or robots block; independently inspect rendered HTML.
releaseGates.dependency: Do not change live URLs or canonicals without migration/redirect review.

releaseGates.title: Facet + pagination policy
releaseGates.evidence: Proposed operational gate informed by the cited public methodology or platform guidance.

source.title: Managing crawling of faceted navigation URLs | Google Crawling Infrastructure
source.note: Google describes the crawl cost of facet combinations and explains why canonical hints alone are less effective crawl control than dedicated controls.

releaseGates.question: Can size, color, price and sort combinations expand crawl space? Are all products discoverable beyond the first grid?
releaseGates.acceptance: Choose allowed indexable facets deliberately; test parameter combinations and separate pagination URLs. Canonical hints alone are not a complete crawl-control plan.
releaseGates.dependency: Do not block crawling before confirming whether Google must read noindex/canonical signals; document ordering and verification.

sources.note: Collections group products for discovery. Shopify documents a new collections model replacing legacy manual/smart collections, with account-dependent availability; menus and sorting remain operational checks.

sources.title: Ecommerce Website Navigation Structure | Google Search Central
sources.note: Google recommends linked category → subcategory → product paths and crawlable anchor links; search-box discovery alone is insufficient.

sources.title: Managing crawling of faceted navigation URLs | Google Crawling Infrastructure
sources.note: Google describes the crawl cost of facet combinations and explains why canonical hints alone are less effective crawl control than dedicated controls.

sources.title: Ecommerce URL Structure Best Practices | Google Search Central
sources.note: Guidance covers consistent canonical URLs, pagination URLs, duplicate alternatives, crawlable links and empty category handling.

sources.title: How To Add Product Snippet Structured Data | Google Search Central
sources.note: Product rich results focus on single products or variants. Google recommends PDP markup and initial-HTML product data; syntax validation does not establish policy eligibility or guarantee appearance.

qaNotes: All example merchants are unnamed and explicitly hypothetical.
No volumes, rankings, inventory counts, revenue projections or margins are invented.
Schema semantics are separated from Google rich-result eligibility.
New Shopify collections model rollout is flagged; legacy-only instructions are avoided.
No universal minimum assortment or SKU-overlap threshold is presented as an SEO rule.
No claim that all Shopify stores require JavaScript rendering or that schema guarantees AI visibility is adopted.
